name: Socialist Workers' Party of Kachakonia
description:
The largest party in Kachakonia in terms of number of members, SWPK is traditionally our main rival on the political scene. Their economic stance is reflected well in the party's name and, no surprise there, they posses strong connections with labour unions. 
    Ideologically, SWPK takes conservative positions and their electorate consists mainly of voters over 50 years of age.
